visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair tied in twin pigtails, wearing a white graphic t-shirt and denim shorts, stands in an indoor playroom. She gazes down at a wooden toy setup. The room features neutral-colored walls and soft white floor padding. (2) The girl holds a round wooden block in her hands as she peers into a rectangular wooden crate. Inside, an orange and white tabby cat is curled up. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the wood. (3) The girl approaches a red and wooden rocking horse. She attempts to climb on, her small hands grasping the wooden handlebar. Scattered wooden blocks are visible on the padded floor, suggesting a play session in progress. (4) The toddler manages to sit on the red seat of the rocking horse but is facing backward, leaning her back against the padded wall. Her expression is calm yet curious as she looks toward the camera. (5) After some guidance, the girl stands up, turns around, and sits properly on the rocking horse, facing the horse's head. She grips the wooden handles and begins to rock back and forth with a small smile. (6) The camera pans back to the orange cat inside the wooden box, who appears sleepy and indifferent to the activity. The focus remains tight on the cat's face as it blinks slowly. (7) The screen transitions to a solid pink background featuring a cute cartoon illustration of the girl and the centered text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" in a white sans-serif font.
